view.summary: Guide a hero up a dungeon seven tiles wide, dodging traps, rivers, Raptures and the White Ice Dragon’s breath. Score is the distance you cover plus the gold you pick up.

overview.title: A run
items: Tap to step forward, swipe to step in that direction (arrow keys on PC); the skill button (Space) casts your hero’s skill
Every hero starts with 200 HP; a trap or monster takes 100, so 2 hits end the run

overview.title: Gold
overview.note: Chance is how often a placed coin / bag / chest actually appears. Some chests are Mimics.

overview.title: Starting further in
overview.note: Once unlocked, a run can start part-way up the dungeon with the skipped distance and some gold already counted. Skipped runs don’t count towards missions.
rows: Reach 80 m in a run from the start
Reach 150 m in a run from the start

pages.title: Dragon Dungeon Run
pages.text:
■ Dragon Dungeon Run is a mini game that takes place in a virtual field created by the Hero, Guillotine.
■ The field is designed to train the Hero and her comrades to break through various traps and monsters in order to reach the White Ice Dragon.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
■ For mobile devices
■ Tap the screen to move the character forward.
■ Tap and swipe the screen to move the character in the direction of the swipe.
■ Tap the skill button to cast a skill.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
■ For PC
■ Use the arrow keys to control the character's movements.
■ Press the space bar to cast a skill.

pages.title: Characters
pages.text:
■ Choose one of the four characters to play.
■ Each character has a different skill with varying usage limits and cooldown times.

pages.title: Traps and Monsters
pages.text:
■ Traps and monsters will hinder the character's movement. Running into them will cause the character's HP to decrease.
■ Some traps and monsters can be destroyed with skills.
■ If the character runs into monsters or enters their alert zone, the monsters will chase them.
■ Entering any area with water will cause the character to die instantly, regardless of their remaining HP.

pages.title: Score
pages.text:
■ The final score is the sum of the distance traveled and the gold collected.
■ There are Mimics mixed in among the gold boxes, so watch out when you collect them.
